recognize_zh: H&E 切片中是一片單一形態的漿細胞樣細胞，細胞核圓且偏位、染色質呈車輪狀（clock-face），細胞質雙染性，少數細胞可見核旁淡染區（hof）與雙核細胞，片狀取代正常組織，符合漿細胞瘤（plasmacytoma）。
features: Diffuse sheets of monomorphic plasma cells separated by thin fibrovascular septa
Medium-sized cells with round, eccentrically placed nuclei
Coarsely clumped cartwheel (clock-face) chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous in most cells
Moderate amphophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm; perinuclear hof visible in only a subset of cells
Occasional binucleate forms; no admixed small lymphocytes, germinal centers or significant mitotic activity
describe_en: Sections show a diffuse, sheet-like proliferation of monomorphic plasma cells separated by delicate fibrovascular septa. The cells have round eccentric nuclei with coarse clock-face chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm; a perinuclear hof is appreciable in only a minority of cells, and occasional binucleate forms are present. There is no significant admixture of small lymphocytes or reactive follicles. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm (plasmacytoma); CD138 and kappa/lambda immunostains or ISH to confirm clonality and evaluation to exclude plasma cell myeloma are recommended.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MZL contains a substantial component of small B cells and monocytoid cells, often colonizing follicles, with CD20-positive cells, unlike this pure plasma cell sheet.
Plasmablastic lymphoma has large cells with vesicular chromatin, prominent central nucleoli and high mitotic and Ki-67 index, often EBER positive.
Reactive plasma cells are polyclonal on kappa/lambda staining and are mixed with lymphocytes and other inflammatory cells rather than forming monomorphic sheets.

ddx.dx: Neuroendocrine tumor or metastatic carcinoma with plasmacytoid cells
ddx.vs: Plasmacytoid carcinoma/neuroendocrine cells grow in nests or trabeculae and are cytokeratin/synaptophysin positive and CD138 variably positive but light-chain negative.
